data.narrative:
Icarus is a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Henry Kwan, whose prior experience includes building spacecraft and space robotics at Orbital, contributing to a $935M NASA space habitat contract, and designing drone flight sciences systems at NASA. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies in Defense & Security, spanning from $125M to $4.0B in valuation.

The peer-median method was applied as the primary triangulation approach. The four comparable companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yield a median valuation of $700M. This reflects the volatility in seed and early-stage Defense & Security valuations, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $595M to $805M, centered at $700M. Key uncertainties include reliance on a single valuation methodology due to limited applicability of revenue or comparable transaction multiples at this stage, the heterogeneity within the peer set (mixing Seed and Series A stages), and the wide dispersion of peer valuations ($3.9B spread). Founder pedigree and security clearance status support positioning toward the higher end, though revenue traction and customer validation data would strengthen conviction in any final valuation within this range.
